Chuck Norris passed away at the age of 86 after a sudden medical emergency while in Hawaii. Throughout his life, Chuck Norris was open about his relationship with Jesus Christ. He spoke how his faith shaped his life, his marriage, and his purpose beyond Hollywood even at the height of fame. In a culture that glorifies self-made success, his story is a reminder: real strength isn’t found in what you can do alone, but in who you trust. 🙏 Strength fades. Fame fades.
